title: PPL Solid Phase Extraction for Chemical Exudates from Marine Macrophytes for LC-MS/MS
author: zabinski
materials: Wash equipment with DI water and Alconox
Setting up tubing and rinsing materials.
Cartridge Drying and Storage until Elution
Experimental Procedure I: Milking the roots for exudates
Experimental Procedure II: Root exudates and tissue collection

Materials in addition to the standard procedure: Water bath (for changing milking incubation temperatures) Alternative: to construct your own water bath (per bath, see image 7 for construction) and Materials list Image 7. Example of “Do-It-Yourself” construction of controlled heated water bath with seedling heating pad (made with BioRender). Be sure to insulate the heating pad between the cardboard and tin foil to avoid temperatures fluctuating due to air exchange.
Procedure: Follow instructures as described in Protocols 2-5.

steps.title: Collect Porewater Samples
steps.instruction: Extract porewater from the seagrass rhizosphere using a Rhizon sampler.

substeps.instruction: Attach a 10cm long Rhizon sampler to a syringe.
Insert the sampler into the rhizosphere at a depth that maximizes root area.
Draw porewater for 15 minutes, replacing syringes as needed.
Transfer collected porewater into sterile 50mL Falcon tubes and store at -20˚C.

steps.title: Prepare Glassware
steps.instruction: Clean and prepare all glassware for use.

substeps.instruction: Rinse glassware with DI water.
Submerge glassware in a 0.1M HCl bath and soak for 1 hour.
Rinse with DI water twice.
Rinse with 100% Methanol.

steps.title: Prepare SPE Station and Reagents
steps.instruction: Set up the Solid Phase Extraction (SPE) hardware and acidification solution.

substeps.instruction: Cut vacuum tubing to the desired length with a precise, flat cut.
Rinse reservoirs and stopcocks with LCMS-grade MeOH, followed by LCMS-grade H2O.
Prepare 0.01M HCl (acidified H2O) by adding 1 mL of 37% LCMS-grade HCl to 1 L of LCMS-grade H2O in an acid-washed 1L glass bottle.
Connect the SPE station to an HDPE vacuum carboy as a solvent flow-through container, leaving one bulkhead fitting open to prevent a vacuum.

steps.title: Activate and Pre-Condition PPL Cartridges
steps.instruction: Prepare PPL cartridges for extraction without letting them run dry between washes.

substeps.instruction: Remove lids on the vacuum station only for ports in use.
Install PPL cartridges for all samples, including an extra port for an LCMS-grade H2O procedural blank.
Wash cartridges in the following order: 3x column volume 100% LCMS grade MeOH, 3x column volume 0.01M HCl, 3x column volume 100% LCMS-grade MeOH, and 3x column volume 0.01M HCl.

steps.title: Extract Chemical Exudates via SPE
steps.instruction: Process the porewater samples through the activated PPL cartridges.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 15 mL of sample into a clean, sterile Falcon tube.
Acidify the sample to 0.01M by adding 150 µL of 1M HCl (targeting pH 2.0).
Pour the sample into the reservoir in ~3mL increments until the total volume (~15mL) has passed through the column via gravity (approx. 8mL/min).
Flush the PPL cartridge with 2 column volumes of 0.01M HCl to remove salt.
Wrap cartridges individually in aluminum foil and freeze at -80˚C (or -20˚C if -80˚C is unavailable) or proceed to elution.

steps.title: Prepare Milking Station
steps.instruction: Set up the materials and environment for root exudate milking.

substeps.instruction: Label Magenta boxes or 50mL conical tubes for each plant, 15mL conical tubes for sediment, 15mL conical tubes for roots/rhizome, 5mL screw cap tubes for exudates, and Whirlpaks for leaves/shoots.
Label slots on 50mL conical foam floats.
Fill spray and squirt bottles with sterile Instant Ocean (IO).
Pre-wet the magenta box floats.
Measure 20 mL of sterile IO into each magenta box or conical tube.
Assemble chambers into float devices and place in the tank until the IO reaches tank temperature; verify temperature with thermometers.

steps.title: Perform Root Milking
steps.instruction: Collect root exudates from the plants.

substeps.instruction: Gently pull the plant from sediment and shake to remove excess sediment.
Rinse adhering sediment into designated 15mL conical tubes using sterile IO; once IO reaches 10-12 mL, shake the roots in the tube to collect ~2-5 mL of sediment.
Finish rinsing the plant using a beaker of sterile IO.
Place the plant in the milking chamber with roots submerged in sterile IO and leaves hanging over the side.
Milk the roots for 3 hours, spraying leaves with IO to prevent drying (monitor closely for the first 20 minutes).
Remove the milking chamber and the plant (including no-plant controls) after the period ends.

steps.title: Process and Store Exudates and Tissue
steps.instruction: Filter the collected exudates and harvest plant tissues.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plunger from a 20 mL syringe, pour in the 20 mL of root exudates, and replace the plunger.
Filter sterilize 5 mL of the root exudates into four 5mL screw cap tubes.
Freeze root exudates and all other samples in a liquid nitrogen shipper/dewar.
Photograph the plant, then use a scalpel to separate leaves/shoots (place in Whirlpak) from roots/rhizome (place in 15mL conical tube).

steps.title: Prepare 1M HCl and Dry Cartridges
steps.instruction: Perform final reagent preparation and cartridge drying for indoor tank setups.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1M HCl by adding 8.33 mL of LCMS-grade HCl to 91.67 mL of LCMS-grade H2O in an acid-washed 100mL glass bottle.
Dry PPL columns in a vacuum concentrator overnight using D-AQ settings with no heat (infinity symbol), ensuring tips do not touch the surface; alternatively, dry under N2 gas.
